title: Glossary
desc: Definitions for the terms used throughout the handbook.
lede: Short definitions for the terms you'll see across the handbook.
body:
At a glance
  • Content terms: project, chapter, segment, chunk.
  • Voice terms: voice, variant, sample, engine.
  • Pipeline terms: task, job, artifact.

Content

  • Project — one book and its settings.
  • Chapter — a unit of text you narrate and assemble.
  • Segment / block — a line or passage assigned to a voice.
  • Chunk — the bounded piece of text actually sent to an engine.

Voices

  • Voice — a reusable voice identity.
  • Variant — a tuned build of a voice for an engine.
  • Sample — audio a variant is built from.
  • Engine — the component that turns text into speech.

Pipeline

  • Task — a unit of work the orchestrator schedules.
  • Job — a queued instance of a task.
  • Artifact — validated output (with metadata) that defines completion.
